meta.title: Layangin — Indonesian kite-fighting game
meta.description: Fly a simulated kite, cross lines with an opponent and cut their line first. Eight airframes, six arenas with real obstacles, upgrades and a coin shop. Plays in the browser, no sign-up.

hero.title: Cross lines.
hero.lead: Layangin is a kite duel played the way it is played on a field at dusk: you only win by wearing through the other line where the two cross. Wind, tension and timing decide it — not button mashing.
hero.note: Runs in your browser. No account, no install.

physics.title: The wind does the work
physics.lead: The kite is not on rails. Every frame it is solved from the air moving over it.

wind.title: Wind that changes with height
wind.body: Wind is slower near the ground and picks up with altitude, following the standard power-law profile. Lose height and you lose lift — which is why altitude is worth fighting for.

aero.title: Lift and drag from angle of attack
aero.body: The sail is solved as a thin plate: lift peaks around 45° and collapses past it. Hold too steep an angle and the kite stalls and drops out of the sky.

line.title: A line that sags and snaps
line.body: Pay line out and the belly drops into a visible catenary; haul in and it goes straight. Load it past its breaking tension in a gust and it parts on its own.

clash.title: Cutting by abrasion
clash.body: Where the lines cross, damage depends on how fast they slide, how hard they press, and which line is tauter. The tighter line acts as the blade.

kites.title: Eight airframes, not eight colours
kites.lead: Each kite is a different shape with different numbers behind it. A long-tailed janggan really is steadier and slower than a bare delta.

ladder.title: Eight opponents, three of them bosses
ladder.lead: Difficulty is in the hands, not the gear. A boss reacts in a fifth of a second and rarely wastes stamina; it does not get a stronger line than you can buy.

progress.title: Earn coins, then choose what to fix
progress.lead: Wins pay, losses still pay a little. Spend it on the thing that keeps beating you.

kites.title: Buy new airframes
kites.body: Each one changes how the kite flies, not just how it looks.

upgrades.title: Upgrade what you have
upgrades.body: Line strength, gelasan, reel speed, control and stamina all feed straight into the simulation.

cosmetics.title: Colours and trails
cosmetics.body: Eight colourways and six trail effects. These are cosmetic only — they never change how a kite flies.

howto.title: Three inputs, a lot of depth
howto.lead: Haul or pay out line, walk along the ground, and yank. That is the whole control scheme.

free.a: Yes, and there is nothing to buy. Coins are earned by playing and only exist inside the game.

account.a: No. Progress is saved in your own browser storage. There is no sign-up and no server holding your data.

device.q: Does it work on a phone?
device.a: Yes. On a touch screen the arena shows an on-screen spool and yank button instead of keyboard controls.

pvp.q: Can I play against a friend?
pvp.a: Not yet. Only matches against the AI are available today. The simulation was built to be deterministic so online play can be added later, but it is not implemented.

offline.a: Not currently. The page needs to load once from the network; there is no offline mode yet.

cta.title: The wind is up
cta.body: One match takes about a minute and a half.
